comment: Android's clipboard backend (com.rungic.clipboard.ClipboardDaemon, run by Magisk as Shell, uid 2000) and its Linux consumer shared/platform/clipboard.py (rungic-plasma-clipboard), which syncs it with the Wayland selection through wl-copy/wl-paste. Framing: the abstract Unix socket com.rungic.clipboard.v1, one JSON object per line each way, one request per connection; the consumer refuses a server that is not uid 2000 (SO_PEERCRED), the daemon answers uid 0, 1000 and the app. Plain text only, at most 65536 characters / 262144 UTF-8 bytes. clipboard-get: available false (with a reason: locked-or-other-user, sensitive, non-text, too-large) leaves the Linux selection alone; text null is an empty Android clipboard. watch: a long poll that answers when the clipboard's version moves or the daemon restarted (a new epoch), at most after timeout ms. Errors are {"error": string}. Tested from both ends: tools/tests/test_contract_clipboard.py (the real clipboard.py against tools/contracts.py's stand-in, fake wl-copy/wl-paste) and acceptance scenario contract.clipboard (the daemon on the phone; the text is blanked on the phone and never read back).
